meta.title: Noezz Homestay – Beach hostel in Da Nang
meta.description: Social homestay 5 minutes from My Khe beach, Da Nang. Dorms, private rooms and family rooms.

demo: Demo website · fictional business · built by Duong Thanh Nam

home.kicker: Da Nang · 5 min to My Khe beach
home.heroTitle: Your Da Nang story starts here
home.heroText: Sunny dorms, private rooms and a rooftop full of new friends. Surf in the morning, street food at night.
home.introText: Noezz is a small, social homestay in An Thuong, the backpacker street of Da Nang. We help you plan trips, rent a motorbike and find the best bánh mì in town.

highlights.title: 5 min to the beach
highlights.text: Walk to My Khe beach with your board. Free beach towels at reception.

highlights.title: Rooftop every night
highlights.text: Family dinner on Fridays, games and sunset drinks with other travelers.

highlights.title: Local hosts
highlights.text: Ask us anything in English or Vietnamese. We help 24/7.

home.roomsText: From budget dorm beds to quiet private rooms.

reviews.name: Lena
reviews.text: Best rooftop in Da Nang. I came for 2 nights and stayed 9.

reviews.name: Tom
reviews.text: Clean dorms, strong Wi-Fi and the hosts sorted my motorbike in 10 minutes.

reviews.name: Mai
reviews.text: Gần biển, giá hợp lý, chủ nhà rất nhiệt tình.

home.bandText: Send us your dates. We reply within a few hours.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.intro: All rooms have air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and daily cleaning. Breakfast is included.

items.name: 6-bed mixed dorm
items.text: Wooden bunks with curtains, a reading light and a personal locker.

items.name: Private double
items.text: A calm room for couples, with a balcony and a view of the street life.

items.name: Family room
items.text: Space for families or friends traveling together, with a mini fridge.

experiences.title: Experiences
experiences.intro: Our favourite things to do around Da Nang. Ask at reception and we will set it up.

items.title: Sunrise at My Khe
items.text: Wake up early for a swim or a surf lesson. We lend boards and towels.

items.title: Lantern night in Hoi An
items.text: Join our weekly group trip to the old town, lanterns and river boats.

items.title: Marble Mountains
items.text: Climb the caves and pagodas, then see the city from the top.

items.title: Motorbike rental
items.text: Automatic or semi-auto bikes with helmets. Ride the Hai Van Pass.

contact.title: Book your stay
